top_matches.tested_construct: CYP11B1 deficiency blocks conversion of 11-deoxycortisol to cortisol and deoxycorticosterone to corticosterone. top_matches.tested_construct: Biallelic loss-of-function MC2R variants impair the adrenal ACTH receptor. The adrenal cortex therefore cannot respond normally to ACTH to generate glucocorticoids, causing very low cortisol with markedly elevated ACTH and hyperpigmentation. Mineralocorticoid secretion is classically preserved, distinguishing isolated ACTH resistance from global primary adrenal destruction or many steroidogenic defects.
top_matches.educational_objective: Recognize familial glucocorticoid deficiency from childhood hypoglycemia, hyperpigmentation, low cortisol, very high ACTH, and preserved mineralocorticoid function and connect it to MC2R-mediated ACTH resistance.

top_matches.tested_construct: Under normoxia, prolyl hydroxylase domain enzymes use molecular oxygen to hydroxylate conserved proline residues on HIF-alpha. top_matches.educational_objective: Explain how oxygen-dependent prolyl hydroxylation enables downstream VHL-mediated recognition, ubiquitination, and degradation of HIF-alpha.
